definitions.explanation: Intensely and entirely yellow, the emphatic form of {黄色|きいろ}. Used for leaves, flowers, signs, and figuratively in a few set phrases.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ}な⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧になってイチョウ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ}になった。
examples.english: Autumn came and the ginkgo trees turned bright yellow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧{真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ}な⟦{菜|な}の{花|はな}→菜の花：14042_nanohana⟧{畑|ばたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていて→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A field of rape blossoms spread out, bright yellow as far as the eye could see, and many people were taking photos.

notes:
FORMS:
The prefix {真|ま}っ intensifies a color word: ⟦{真|ま}っ{赤|か}→真っ赤：03734_makka⟧, ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧, ⟦{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ}→真っ黒：07614_makkuro⟧, ⟦{真|ま}っ{青|さお}→真っ青：07615_massao⟧. {真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ} keeps the ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ of ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧; the i-adjective {真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ}い is also used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{色|いろ}づく→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧: to turn bright yellow (leaves)
- {真|ま}っ{黄色|きいろ}な⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧: a bright yellow sign

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧: yellow (the plain color word)
